name: TiaDar
detailed_description:
The world of TiaDaR is not just a battlefield, but a living pattern of destinies, where every hero is a shard of an impending catastrophe. Here magic is intertwined with steel, and ancient gods play with the fate of mortals, pushing the world to imminent destruction. Every swing of the sword, every spell changes the course of events in this world plunged into chaos. Choose from a variety of unique characters and uncover their stories as they weave together a grandiose legend. Through whose eyes will you face the apocalypse? Whose secrets have the power to tear this world apart?

Ruthless Combat:

Fight in third-person in dynamic skirmishes. Slaughter hordes of monsters and dodge magical projectiles.

Tactics and Survival:

Every battle is a test of tactics and skill. Combine fighting styles, use the environment to your advantage: collapse vaults on enemies, lure them into traps. But don't let your guard down - the world of TiaDaR is merciless, and one mistake can be your last.

Atmospheric fantasy with contrasts:

Explore gloomy dungeons, blooming magical groves and ruined castles filled with secrets. An emotional tale of betrayal, redemption and the absurdity of war awaits you, where tragic twists and turns are juxtaposed with absurd situations.

The world through the eyes of unique characters:

Each character has a different destiny, different motivations. Explore their past through artifacts that bring memories to life. One character's decisions are reflected in the lives of others, changing the world itself. The more fates you uncover, the closer you get to the truth. Each story is part of the great mystery of TiaDaR.

Key features:

  • Dynamic battles - a combination of Hack & Slash and TPS: chop, sorcery, shoot, combine combat styles.

  • Deep role-playing system - develop skills, customize your combat style to fit your strategy.

  • Tactical survival - make use of your surroundings: collapse vaults, trap enemies, maneuver in combat.

  • Destinies instead of endings - explore the story from different angles, playing as different characters with unique goals and motivations.

English, Russian*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Turkish, Japanese
*languages with full audio support

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4690, AMD FX-4350, or equivalent
